scope: 20 workloads, no RoPE, unfolded GPU tables, same seeded 2.8365B BF16 model. Current controls rerun; do not use previous environment timings as paired controls.
statistics: Three paired process-block means; two-sided Student-t 95% CI df2. Rotate the 3 placements by block; each placement occupies each position once for EVERY workload.
failure_policy: Keep OOMs; skip identical OOM repeats only. Stop on other failures or correctness mismatch. No stopping for slow timings.
environment_note: Unrelated process holds about 6994 MiB on GPU, vs about654 MiB in original baseline; never terminate it. Capacity results belong to current environment.
